title: vuln-triage-roundtable-bridgework-2026-07-07
summary: Notes from the ad-hoc vulnerability triage roundtable focused on two active findings, secrets exposure follow-up, and a short threat modeling refresh for the new batch routing feature. Meeting aimed to align owners, immediate mitigations, and a 2-week remediation window for medium/critical items.
agenda: 1) Quick context and scope (5m) 2) Triage UCS-2026-07 and KV-leak finding (25m) 3) Secrets rotation status and gaps (15m) 4) Threat-model check on batch routing prototype (10m) 5) Action items and owners (5m)
discussion_notes:
- Quick context: active customer report of unusual 5xx spikes tied to a throttling fallback. Infra showed fallback route used older model variant; initial hypothesis: stale routing metadata + config drift.
- UCS-2026-07: runtime kernel returns malformed attention masks when sequence=0; affects a subset of small-batch requests. Regressed after runtime change 2026-06-30.
- KV-leak: SRE found logs with partial KV cache keys in debug dump shipped to logging for 48h before indexed; exposure window limited but contains hashed prefixes.
- Secrets rotation: current rotation job succeeded for 95% of instances; 5% failed in eu-west-2 due to missing IAM perms on a transient worker pool. Root cause: new autoscaling group launched with stale launch template.
- Batch routing threat-model: new router will hand off requests between pools. Concern: cross-customer routing permission boundaries, metadata leakage via prefix caching, and fallback chaining causing amplification of fingerprinting surface.
vulnerabilities_discussed: UCS-2026-07: malformed-attention-mask - severity: high - owner: Renee Huang - status: triaged - immediate: revert runtime change or deploy hotfix that bounds seq len checks - timeline: hotfix within 48h or rollback

KV-LOG-EXPOSE-06-30: partial-kv-keys-in-logs - severity: medium - owner: Lina Ortiz - status: investigating - immediate: stop debug logging, revoke affected log indexer keys, reingest sanitized set - timeline: mitigation today, validation by end of week

IAM-ROT-FAIL-EU: rotation-failures-eu-west-2 - severity: medium - owner: Miguel Santos - status: assigned - immediate: patch launch template, run manual rotation, monitor - timeline: patch + rotation within 24h
secrets_review:
- Confirmed affected logs contained hashed prefixes only; still treat as sensitive until proven otherwise.
- Action: revoke and reissue indexer creds used during window. Jamal to file JIRA (JIRA-SEC-441) for key revocation and downstream reindex.
- Rotation gaps: autoscaling template drift is recurring; short-term fix: enforce templated SSM parameter used by ASG builds. Longer-term: introduce post-launch compliance check in bake pipeline.
- Note: we discussed adding a 'rotated-at' header to service responses for auditability but deprioritized for now due to perf impact.
threat_modeling:
- New batch routing prototype threat surface: 1) routing metadata privacy (customer id leakage via cache keys), 2) fallback chaining loop that could be used for differential probing, 3) cross-tenant resource exhaustion via planned bursts.
- Proposed mitigations: namespace all prefix caches with monotonic per-tenant salts, enforce request-level metadata scrubbing before routing decisions, add budget-limited fallback counters and per-tenant rate ceilings, and add randomized jitter to fallback timing to make probing noisy.
- Decision: prototype will adopt namespaced cache + scrub pipeline in the next rollout. Team to validate with focused fuzz tests and an adversarial probe harness (Renee owns test harness).
decisions: Revert or hotfix UCS-2026-07 within 48h; rollback if hotfix not ready
Stop debug-level logging immediately and revoke indexer keys related to KV exposure
Patch autoscaling launch template and run manual secret rotation in eu-west-2 within 24h
Batch-routing prototype to include namespaced cache keys and metadata scrubbing before any cross-pool handoff

Lina: remove debug logging, validate no lingering debug config across clusters, report by EOD (today)
Jamal: open JIRA-SEC-441 to track log indexer key revocation and reindexing plan (by tomorrow)
Miguel: patch ASG launch template and trigger manual secret rotation in eu-west-2 (24h)
Renee: own adversarial probe harness for batch routing and run initial run before next sync
Aisha: validate that monitoring alerts will catch fallback-chain amplification and add a short runbook snippet
